verses.original: וַיָּב֤וֹא אֵלַי֙ אֲנָשִׁ֔ים מִזִּקְנֵ֖י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיֵּשְׁב֖וּ לְפָנָֽי׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·ḇō·w ’ê·lay ’ă·nā·šîm miz·ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl way·yê·šə·ḇū lə·p̄ā·nāy
verses.literal: Then some of the elders of Israel came - and sat down before me
verses.literalPt: Então, vieram ter comigo alguns dos anciãos de Israel e se assentaram diante de mim.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Veio a mim a palavra de Jeová, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם הָאֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ הֶעֱל֤וּ גִלּֽוּלֵיהֶם֙ עַל־ לִבָּ֔ם וּמִכְשׁ֣וֹל עֲוֺנָ֔ם נָתְנ֖וּ נֹ֣כַח פְּנֵיהֶ֑ם הַאִדָּרֹ֥שׁ אִדָּרֵ֖שׁ לָהֶֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·’êl·leh he·‘ĕ·lū ḡil·lū·lê·hem ‘al- lib·bām ū·miḵ·šō·wl ‘ă·wō·nām nā·ṯə·nū nō·ḵaḥ pə·nê·hem ha·’id·dā·rōš ’id·dā·rêš lā·hem
verses.literal: Son of man these men have set up idols in their hearts and put wicked stumbling blocks before their faces Should I consult with them in any way
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, estes homens deram lugar no seu coração aos seus ídolos e puseram diante da sua face o tropeço da sua iniquidade; acaso, permitirei que eles me consultem?

verses.original: לָכֵ֣ן דַּבֵּר־ א֠וֹתָם וְאָמַרְתָּ֨ אֲלֵיהֶ֜ם כֹּה־ אָמַ֣ר׀ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֗ה אִ֣ישׁ אִ֣ישׁ מִבֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֡ל אֲשֶׁר֩ יַעֲלֶ֨ה אֶת־ גִּלּוּלָ֜יו אֶל־ לִבּ֗וֹ וּמִכְשׁ֤וֹל עֲוֺנוֹ֙ יָשִׂים֙ נֹ֣כַח פָּנָ֔יו וּבָ֖א אֶל־ הַנָּבִ֑יא אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה נַעֲנֵ֧יתִי ל֦וֹ בָהּ בְּרֹ֥ב גִּלּוּלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên dab·bêr- ’ō·w·ṯām wə·’ā·mar·tā ’ă·lê·hem kōh- ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’îš ’îš mib·bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·leh ’eṯ- gil·lū·lāw ’el- lib·bōw ū·miḵ·šō·wl ‘ă·wō·nōw yā·śîm nō·ḵaḥ pā·nāw ū·ḇā ’el- han·nā·ḇî ’ă·nî Yah·weh na·‘ă·nê·ṯî lōw ḇå̄h bə·rōḇ gil·lū·lāw
verses.literal: Therefore speak to them and tell them that this is what the Lord GOD says When any . . . Israelite sets up idols in his heart and puts a wicked stumbling block before his face and then comes to the prophet I the LORD will answer him according to his great idolatry
verses.literalPt: Portanto, fala com eles e dize-lhes: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Todo homem da casa de Israel que der lugar no seu coração aos seus ídolos, e puser diante da sua face o tropeço da sua iniquidade, e vier ter com o profeta, eu, Jeová, lhe responderei nisso segundo a multidão dos seus ídolos;

verses.original: לְמַ֛עַן תְּפֹ֥שׂ אֶת־ בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בְּלִבָּ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָזֹ֙רוּ֙ מֵֽעָלַ֔י בְּגִלּֽוּלֵיהֶ֖ם כֻּלָּֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an tə·p̄ōś ’eṯ- bêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl bə·lib·bām ’ă·šer nā·zō·rū mê·‘ā·lay bə·ḡil·lū·lê·hem kul·lām
verses.literal: so that I may take hold of the hearts of the people of Israel For because of their idols they are all estranged from Me
verses.literalPt: para que eu apanhe a casa de Israel no seu coração, porque são todos alienados de mim pelos seus ídolos.

verses.original: לָכֵ֞ן אֱמֹ֣ר׀ אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל כֹּ֤ה אָמַר֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה שׁ֣וּבוּ וְהָשִׁ֔יבוּ מֵעַ֖ל גִּלּֽוּלֵיכֶ֑ם וּמֵעַ֥ל כָּל־ תּוֹעֲבֹתֵיכֶ֖ם הָשִׁ֥יבוּ פְנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: lā·ḵên ’ĕ·mōr ’el- bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl kōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh šū·ḇū wə·hā·šî·ḇū mê·‘al gil·lū·lê·ḵem ū·mê·‘al kāl- tō·w·‘ă·ḇō·ṯê·ḵem hā·šî·ḇū p̄ə·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: Therefore tell . . . the house of Israel that this is what the Lord GOD says Repent and turn away from your idols turn your faces away from all your abominations
verses.literalPt: Portanto, dize à casa de Israel: Assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Convertei-vos, e apartai-vos dos vossos ídolos, e desviai os vossos rostos de todas as vossas abominações.

verses.original: כִּי֩ אִ֨ישׁ אִ֜ישׁ מִבֵּ֣ית יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל וּמֵהַגֵּר֮ אֲשֶׁר־ יָג֣וּר בְּיִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וְיִנָּזֵ֣ר מֵֽאַחֲרַ֗י וְיַ֤עַל גִּלּוּלָיו֙ אֶל־ לִבּ֔וֹ וּמִכְשׁ֣וֹל עֲוֺנ֔וֹ יָשִׂ֖ים נֹ֣כַח פָּנָ֑יו וּבָ֤א אֶל־ הַנָּבִיא֙ לִדְרָשׁ־ ל֣וֹ בִ֔י אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֔ה נַֽעֲנֶה־ לּ֖וֹ בִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’îš ’îš mib·bêṯ yiś·rā·’êl ū·mê·hag·gêr ’ă·šer- yā·ḡūr bə·yiś·rā·’êl wə·yin·nā·zêr mê·’a·ḥă·ray wə·ya·‘al gil·lū·lāw ’el- lib·bōw ū·miḵ·šō·wl ‘ă·wō·nōw yā·śîm nō·ḵaḥ pā·nāw ū·ḇā ’el- han·nā·ḇî liḏ·rāš- lōw ḇî ’ă·nî Yah·weh na·‘ă·neh- lōw bî
verses.literal: For when any . . . Israelite or any foreigner dwelling in Israel separates himself from Me sets up idols in his heart and puts a wicked stumbling block before his face and then comes to the prophet to inquire of Me I the LORD will answer him Myself
verses.literalPt: Pois qualquer homem da casa de Israel ou dos estrangeiros que peregrinam em Israel que se alienar de mim, e der lugar no seu coração aos seus ídolos, e puser diante da sua face o tropeço da sua iniquidade, e vier ter com o profeta, a fim de me consultar a favor de si mesmo, eu lhe responderei de mim mesmo.

verses.original: וְנָתַתִּ֨י פָנַ֜י בָּאִ֣ישׁ הַה֗וּא וַהֲשִֽׂמֹתִ֙יהוּ֙ לְא֣וֹת וְלִמְשָׁלִ֔ים וְהִכְרַתִּ֖יו מִתּ֣וֹךְ עַמִּ֑י וִֽידַעְתֶּ֖ם כִּֽי־ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯat·tî p̄ā·nay bā·’îš ha·hū wa·hă·śi·mō·ṯî·hū lə·’ō·wṯ wə·lim·šā·lîm wə·hiḵ·rat·tîw mit·tō·wḵ ‘am·mî wî·ḏa‘·tem kî- ’ă·nî Yah·weh
verses.literal: I will set My face against that man and make him a sign and a proverb I will cut him off from among My people Then you will know that I am the LORD
verses.literalPt: Porei o meu rosto contra o tal homem, e o farei um objeto de espanto, para servir de provérbio, e o exterminarei do meio do meu povo; e sabereis que eu sou Jeová.

verses.original: וְהַנָּבִ֤יא כִֽי־ יְפֻתֶּה֙ וְדִבֶּ֣ר דָּבָ֔ר אֲנִ֤י יְהוָה֙ פִּתֵּ֔יתִי אֵ֖ת הַנָּבִ֣יא הַה֑וּא וְנָטִ֤יתִי אֶת־ יָדִי֙ עָלָ֔יו וְהִ֨שְׁמַדְתִּ֔יו מִתּ֖וֹךְ עַמִּ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·han·nā·ḇî ḵî- yə·p̄ut·teh wə·ḏib·ber dā·ḇār ’ă·nî Yah·weh pit·tê·ṯî ’êṯ han·nā·ḇî ha·hū wə·nā·ṭî·ṯî ’eṯ- yā·ḏî ‘ā·lāw wə·hiš·maḏ·tîw mit·tō·wḵ ‘am·mî yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: But if the prophet is enticed to speak a message then it was I the LORD who enticed him . . . and I will stretch out My hand against him and destroy him from among My people Israel
verses.literalPt: Se o profeta for enganado e falar alguma palavra, eu, Jeová, enganei esse profeta, estenderei a minha mão sobre ele e o destruirei do meio do meu povo de Israel.

verses.original: וְנָשְׂא֖וּ עֲוֺנָ֑ם כַּֽעֲוֺן֙ הַדֹּרֵ֔שׁ כַּעֲוֺ֥ן הַנָּבִ֖יא יִֽהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·śə·’ū ‘ă·wō·nām ka·‘ă·wōn had·dō·rêš ka·‘ă·wōn han·nā·ḇî yih·yeh
verses.literal: They will bear their punishment the punishment of the inquirer will be the same as that of the prophet
verses.literalPt: Eles levarão sobre si a sua iniquidade; a iniquidade do profeta será como a iniquidade de quem o consultar;

verses.original: לְ֠מַעַן לֹֽא־ יִתְע֨וּ ע֤וֹד בֵּֽית־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ מֵאַֽחֲרַ֔י וְלֹֽא־ יִטַּמְּא֥וּ ע֖וֹד בְּכָל־ פִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֑ם וְהָ֥יוּ לִ֣י לְעָ֗ם וַֽאֲנִי֙ אֶהְיֶ֤ה לָהֶם֙ לֵֽאלֹהִ֔ים נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: lə·ma·‘an lō- yiṯ·‘ū ‘ō·wḏ bêṯ- yiś·rā·’êl mê·’a·ḥă·ray wə·lō- yiṭ·ṭam·mə·’ū ‘ō·wḏ bə·ḵāl piš·‘ê·hem wə·hā·yū lî lə·‘ām wa·’ă·nî ’eh·yeh lā·hem lê·lō·hîm nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: in order that the house of Israel may no longer stray from Me and no longer defile themselves with all their transgressions Then they will be My people and I will be their God declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: para que a casa de Israel não se desvie mais de mim, nem se contamine mais com todas as suas transgressões; mas que sejam eles o meu povo, e seja eu o seu Deus, diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḏə·ḇar- Yah·weh ’ê·lay lê·mōr
verses.literal: And the word of the LORD came to me saying
verses.literalPt: Veio a mim a palavra de Jeová, dizendo:

verses.original: בֶּן־ אָדָ֗ם אֶ֚רֶץ כִּ֤י תֶחֱטָא־ לִי֙ לִמְעָל־ מַ֔עַל וְנָטִ֤יתִי יָדִי֙ עָלֶ֔יהָ וְשָׁבַ֥רְתִּי לָ֖הּ מַטֵּה־ לָ֑חֶם וְהִשְׁלַחְתִּי־ בָ֣הּ רָעָ֔ב וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖נָּה אָדָ֥ם וּבְהֵמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ben- ’ā·ḏām ’e·reṣ kî ṯe·ḥĕ·ṭā- lî lim·‘āl- ma·‘al wə·nā·ṭî·ṯî yā·ḏî ‘ā·le·hā wə·šā·ḇar·tî lāh maṭ·ṭêh- lā·ḥem wə·hiš·laḥ·tî- ḇāh rā·‘āḇ wə·hiḵ·rat·tî mim·men·nāh ’ā·ḏām ū·ḇə·hê·māh
verses.literal: Son of man if a land sins against Me by acting unfaithfully . . . and I stretch out My hand against it to cut off its supply of food to send famine upon it and to cut off from it both man and beast
verses.literalPt: Filho do homem, quando contra mim pecar uma terra, cometendo uma transgressão, e eu estender a minha mão sobre ela, e quebrar o báculo do seu pão, e enviar contra ela a fome, e dela exterminar homens e animais;

verses.original: וְ֠הָיוּ שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֤ים הָאֵ֙לֶּה֙ בְּתוֹכָ֔הּ נֹ֖חַ דָּנִאֵל וְאִיּ֑וֹב הֵ֤מָּה בְצִדְקָתָם֙ יְנַצְּל֣וּ נַפְשָׁ֔ם נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהוִֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yū šə·lō·šeṯ hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·’êl·leh bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh nō·aḥ då̄·ni·ʾēl wə·’î·yō·wḇ hêm·māh ḇə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯām yə·naṣ·ṣə·lū nap̄·šām nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: then even if these three men Noah Daniel and Job were in it their righteousness could deliver only themselves declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: ainda que estivessem nela estes três homens, Noé, Daniel e Jó, livrariam eles tão somente as suas almas pela sua justiça, diz o Senhor Jeová.

verses.original: לֽוּ־ חַיָּ֥ה רָעָ֛ה אַעֲבִ֥יר בָּאָ֖רֶץ וְשִׁכְּלָ֑תָּה וְהָיְתָ֤ה שְׁמָמָה֙ מִבְּלִ֣י עוֹבֵ֔ר מִפְּנֵ֖י הַחַיָּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: lū- ḥay·yāh rā·‘āh ’a·‘ă·ḇîr bā·’ā·reṣ wə·šik·kə·lāt·tāh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh šə·mā·māh mib·bə·lî ‘ō·w·ḇêr mip·pə·nê ha·ḥay·yāh
verses.literal: Or if I send wild . . . beasts through the land to leave it childless and desolate with no man passing through it for fear of the beasts
verses.literalPt: Se eu fizer passar pela terra bestas-feras, e estas a despojarem, de sorte que seja desolada, sem que ninguém possa passar por ela por causa das feras,

verses.original: שְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָאֵלֶּה֮ בְּתוֹכָהּ֒ חַי־ אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אִם־ בָּנִ֥ים וְאִם־ בָּנ֖וֹת יַצִּ֑ילוּ הֵ֤מָּה לְבַדָּם֙ יִנָּצֵ֔לוּ וְהָאָ֖רֶץ תִּהְיֶ֥ה שְׁמָמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: šə·lō·šeṯ hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·’êl·leh bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh ḥay- ’ā·nî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’im- bā·nîm wə·’im- bā·nō·wṯ yaṣ·ṣî·lū hêm·māh lə·ḇad·dām yin·nā·ṣê·lū wə·hā·’ā·reṣ tih·yeh šə·mā·māh
verses.literal: then as surely as I live declares the Lord GOD even if these three men were in it they could not deliver their own sons or daughters They alone would be delivered but the land would be desolate
verses.literalPt: embora estejam nela esses três homens, pela minha vida, diz o Senhor Jeová, não livrarão nem a seus filhos nem a suas filhas; eles tão somente serão livrados, mas a terra será desolada.

verses.original: א֛וֹ חֶ֥רֶב אָבִ֖יא עַל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַהִ֑יא וְאָמַרְתִּ֗י חֶ֚רֶב תַּעֲבֹ֣ר בָּאָ֔רֶץ וְהִכְרַתִּ֥י מִמֶּ֖נָּה אָדָ֥ם וּבְהֵמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw ḥe·reḇ ’ā·ḇî ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ ha·hî wə·’ā·mar·tî ḥe·reḇ ta·‘ă·ḇōr bā·’ā·reṣ wə·hiḵ·rat·tî mim·men·nāh ’ā·ḏām ū·ḇə·hê·māh
verses.literal: Or if I bring a sword against that land and say Let a sword pass through it so that I cut off from it both man and beast
verses.literalPt: Ou, se eu fizer vir a espada sobre essa terra e disser: Espada, passa pela terra, de sorte que eu extermine dela homens e animais,

verses.original: וּשְׁלֹ֨שֶׁת הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָאֵלֶּה֮ בְּתוֹכָהּ֒ חַי־ אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה לֹ֥א יַצִּ֖ילוּ בָּנִ֣ים וּבָנ֑וֹת כִּ֛י הֵ֥ם לְבַדָּ֖ם יִנָּצֵֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·lō·šeṯ hā·’ă·nā·šîm hā·’êl·leh bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh ḥay- ’ā·nî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh lō yaṣ·ṣî·lū bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ kî hêm lə·ḇad·dām yin·nā·ṣê·lū
verses.literal: then as surely as I live declares the Lord GOD even if these three men were in it they could not deliver their own sons or daughters They alone would be delivered
verses.literalPt: embora estejam nela esses três homens, pela minha vida, diz o Senhor Jeová, não livrarão nem a filhos nem a filhas, porém tão somente eles serão livrados.

verses.original: א֛וֹ דֶּ֥בֶר אֲשַׁלַּ֖ח אֶל־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַהִ֑יא וְשָׁפַכְתִּ֨י חֲמָתִ֤י עָלֶ֙יהָ֙ בְּדָ֔ם לְהַכְרִ֥ית מִמֶּ֖נָּה אָדָ֥ם וּבְהֵמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’ōw de·ḇer ’ă·šal·laḥ ’el- hā·’ā·reṣ ha·hî wə·šā·p̄aḵ·tî ḥă·mā·ṯî ‘ā·le·hā bə·ḏām lə·haḵ·rîṯ mim·men·nāh ’ā·ḏām ū·ḇə·hê·māh
verses.literal: Or if I send a plague into that land and pour out My wrath upon it through bloodshed cutting off from it both man and beast
verses.literalPt: Ou, se eu enviar a peste contra essa terra e derramar sobre ela o meu furor em sangue, a fim de exterminar dela homens e animais,

verses.original: וְנֹ֨חַ דָּנִאֵל וְאִיּוֹב֮ בְּתוֹכָהּ֒ חַי־ אָ֗נִי נְאֻם֙ אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהוִ֔ה אִם־ בֵּ֥ן אִם־ בַּ֖ת יַצִּ֑ילוּ הֵ֥מָּה בְצִדְקָתָ֖ם יַצִּ֥ילוּ נַפְשָֽׁם׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·nō·aḥ då̄·ni·ʾēl wə·’î·yō·wḇ bə·ṯō·w·ḵāh ḥay- ’ā·nî nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’im- bên ’im- baṯ yaṣ·ṣî·lū hêm·māh ḇə·ṣiḏ·qā·ṯām yaṣ·ṣî·lū nap̄·šām
verses.literal: then as surely as I live declares the Lord GOD even if Noah Daniel and Job were in it they could not deliver their own sons or daughters Their righteousness could deliver only themselves
verses.literalPt: embora estejam nela Noé, Daniel e Jó, pela minha vida, diz o Senhor Jeová, não livrarão nem o filho nem a filha; eles tão somente livrarão as suas almas pela sua justiça.

verses.original: כִּי֩ כֹ֨ה אָמַ֜ר אֲדֹנָ֣י יְהֹוִ֗ה אַ֣ף כִּֽי־ אַרְבַּ֣עַת שְׁפָטַ֣י׀ הָרָעִ֡ים חֶ֠רֶב וְרָעָ֞ב וְחַיָּ֤ה רָעָה֙ וָדֶ֔בֶר שִׁלַּ֖חְתִּי אֶל־ יְרוּשָׁלִָ֑ם לְהַכְרִ֥ית מִמֶּ֖נָּה אָדָ֥ם וּבְהֵמָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: kî ḵōh ’ā·mar ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh ’ap̄ kî- ’ar·ba·‘aṯ šə·p̄ā·ṭay hā·rā·‘îm ḥe·reḇ wə·rā·‘āḇ wə·ḥay·yāh rā·‘āh wā·ḏe·ḇer šil·laḥ·tî ’el- yə·rū·šā·lim lə·haḵ·rîṯ mim·men·nāh ’ā·ḏām ū·ḇə·hê·māh
verses.literal: For this is what the Lord GOD says How much worse will it be when I send against Jerusalem My four dire judgments sword famine wild beasts and plague in order to cut off from it both man and beast
verses.literalPt: Pois assim diz o Senhor Jeová: Quanto mais, quando eu enviar sobre Jerusalém os meus quatro juízos violentos, a espada, e a fome, e as feras, e a peste, para exterminar dela homens e animais?

verses.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה נֽוֹתְרָה־ בָּ֜הּ פְּלֵטָ֗ה הַֽמּוּצָאִים֮ בָּנִ֣ים וּבָנוֹת֒ הִנָּם֙ יוֹצְאִ֣ים אֲלֵיכֶ֔ם וּרְאִיתֶ֥ם אֶת־ דַּרְכָּ֖ם וְאֶת־ עֲלִֽילוֹתָ֑ם וְנִחַמְתֶּ֗ם עַל־ הָֽרָעָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר הֵבֵ֙אתִי֙ עַל־ יְר֣וּשָׁלִַ֔ם אֵ֛ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר הֵבֵ֖אתִי עָלֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh nō·wṯ·rāh- bāh pə·lê·ṭāh ham·mū·ṣā·’îm bā·nîm ū·ḇā·nō·wṯ hin·nām yō·wṣ·’îm ’ă·lê·ḵem ū·rə·’î·ṯem ’eṯ- dar·kām wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·lî·lō·w·ṯām wə·ni·ḥam·tem ‘al- hā·rā·‘āh ’ă·šer hê·ḇê·ṯî ‘al- yə·rū·šā·lim ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer hê·ḇê·ṯî ‘ā·le·hā
verses.literal: Yet , behold some survivors will be left in it sons and daughters . . . who will be brought out They will come out to you and when you see their conduct and actions you will be comforted regarding the disaster I have brought upon Jerusalem all that I have brought upon it
verses.literalPt: Contudo, eis que nela ficará um resto, que será tirado para fora, tanto filhos como filhas; eis que sairão a ter convosco, e vós vereis o seu caminho e os seus feitos. Ficareis consolados do mal que fiz vir sobre Jerusalém, sim, de tudo o que fiz sobre ela.

verses.original: וְנִחֲמ֣וּ אֶתְכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ תִרְא֥וּ אֶת־ דַּרְכָּ֖ם וְאֶת־ עֲלִֽילוֹתָ֑ם וִֽידַעְתֶּ֗ם כִּי֩ לֹ֨א חִנָּ֤ם עָשִׂ֙יתִי֙ אֵ֣ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂ֣יתִי בָ֔הּ נְאֻ֖ם אֲדֹנָ֥י יְהֹוִֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·ni·ḥă·mū ’eṯ·ḵem kî- ṯir·’ū ’eṯ- dar·kām wə·’eṯ- ‘ă·lî·lō·w·ṯām wî·ḏa‘·tem kî lō ḥin·nām ‘ā·śî·ṯî ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śî·ṯî ḇāh nə·’um ’ă·ḏō·nāy Yah·weh
verses.literal: They will bring you consolation when you see their conduct and actions and you will know that it was not without cause that I have done all these things within it declares the Lord GOD
verses.literalPt: Eles vos consolarão, quando virdes o seu caminho e os seus feitos; e conhecereis que não fiz sem motivo tudo o que nela tenho feito, diz o Senhor Jeová.
